# Guck

Type: Material | Internal ID: Guck | Source: Abomination, ,, Gucksack | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Guck are resources dropped by Abominations and Gucksacks in Swamps.
They can be used to refuel Standing green-burning iron torches.

### Building

• Green banner
• Standing green-burning iron torch

### Crafting

• Draugr fang
• Green firework

### Refueling

• Standing green-burning iron torch

## Notes

• Gucksacks are not damaged by ranged attacks and must be mined with an axe or pickaxe. Players must build elevated platforms or ladders to reach the Gucksacks.
• Guck's texture is a prototype from Resin.
